text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning sex was almost certainly not a factor in choosing him over you. While an all-male panel may reflect broader gender representation issues within the bank's leadership, raising sex in this context is completely unfounded and would damage your professional reputation. 

For a head of department role, panels frequently prioritize executive regulatory affairs experience over technical or academic credentials like a PhD. Furthermore, a two-week delay for written HR feedback is standard corporate bureaucracy, not evidence of foul play. 

Instead of questioning panel composition, send a polite follow-up asking purely for constructive feedback on how to position yourself for future leadership opportunities.
